title: Active ragdolls (joint limits, muscles, balance, falls)

items.name: Anatomical joint limits: Rapier spherical joints with per-axis swing/twist limits (spine, neck, shoulders, hips, ankles) measured from the rig's rest pose; revolute knees and elbows that flex one way only
items.evidence: src/npc/ragdoll.js LIMITS + hinge guard; wrong-way / over-folded knees: gun 3.12 -> 0.24 rad, car 3.13 -> 0.87, stairs 3.02 -> 0.30 (docs/v2/shots/ragdoll/before.json, after.json)

items.name: No self-intersection: 15 capsules sized to body parts (wide pelvis and chest), 5 collision classes (torso, each arm, each leg) that collide with each other, jointed neighbours skip contacts
items.evidence: frames with limb interpenetration (>2.5 cm) gun/car/stairs: 238/254/72 before -> 0/2/0 after

items.name: Muscles: implicit PD motor per joint toward the pose at impact, torque applied in equal and opposite pairs, strength fading 0.5-1.5 s by hit kind and power, joint-friction floor (no jitter, never infinitely floppy)
Balance on survivable hits: hit leg goes weak, other braces, capture-point stumble steps, leg/core support as internal force pairs; recovery blends straight back to animation
items.evidence: docs/v2/shots/ragdoll/after_shove.png and after_punch.png (stumble steps, keeps the feet, blends back to idle at ~0.9 s)

items.name: Falls: arms reach toward the fall direction, chin tucks on backward falls, arms soften after landing
Car impacts: per-height impact velocity (legs swept, upper body lags) so the body rolls onto the hood; CCD on for car hits
Getting up / death: get up as soon as the body has lain still 0.5 s (cap getUpT + 2.5 s), dead frozen in their pose, pose handed back under the moved root before the get-up blend (no pop)
items.evidence: city slope punch: down -> gettingUp at 3.8 s -> flee (docs/v2/shots/ragdoll/city.json)

items.name: Physics: muscles and balance run per fixed substep in game.fixedHooks, bodies sleep when still, cap on active ragdolls (oldest frozen first)
items.evidence: city, 6 lethal ragdolls at once: ragdoll physics 0.17 ms per substep avg (0.3 max), all 6 frozen within 5 s (city.json, city_six.png)

items.name: Bench: src/npc/bench/ragdoll.html + tools/v2/ragdoll-shots.mjs (frame strips + interpenetration / knee / neck metrics)
Braced stumble: core, neck and hip extension limits tighter while balancing, 65% of the blow moves the whole body, so the person steps instead of folding
items.evidence: after_punch.png, after_shove.png; spine extension -0.43 -> -0.20 rad (node check)

items.name: Car hit on a real street (vehicles module's own hit test at 40 km/h)
Heavy punch on an 8.5 degree slope
items.evidence: city_slope_1.png / city_slope_2.png: falls, gets up when settled, flees

items.name: Remaining: still a visible backward lean from the ankles and hips in a heavy-punch stumble; on slopes the balance controller cannot keep the feet (falls); car tumble after landing still rough; neck can over-bend under a car (2.0 rad once)
items.evidence: after_punch.png 0.45-1.0 s, city.json slope, after.json car
